limits: Author-preprint extraction plus pinned artifact and PDF table crosscheck; no experiment was rerun. extracted_fields.hardware_or_process_assumptions: Classical quantum-synthesis software evaluation; the captured source identifies an Apple M4 Max with 36 GB RAM for the reported implementation environment and the artifact is a C++/CMake mapper. extracted_fields.workload_or_design_corpus: Six EPFL arithmetic circuits plus cryptographic/circuit synthesis cases; exact-T precomputation is bounded to N <= 7 total qubits, with larger instances using suboptimal library solutions. The captured correctness harness includes a majority-3 fixture and checks basis-state outputs/probability, but not relative phases for arbitrary superpositions.

limits: Author-preprint and pinned-artifact extraction with a build/QASM-emission smoke test; no simulation, equivalence check or benchmark metric was reproduced. The official 16% and preprint 14.3% headline values remain an unresolved source discrepancy; T-count reduction is not quantum-hardware speedup, global optimality or unrestricted unitary correctness.
title: Quantum Circuit Synthesis Using an Exact T Library
